Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.complete

Class TypingHints

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.complete.TypingHints
public class TypingHints extends Object
Provides real-time typing hints, suggestions, and visual feedback for the command palette input. It analyses user input (tokens) to suggest command names, validate argument types, and highlight potential errors or matches. This includes tab completion for command names, argument type checking (e.g., Vector3, Colour, UUID, numbers, booleans, arg sets), and styling of usage strings to indicate correctness or partial matches.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public void parse(ArrayList<CmdToken> init, boolean endsWithSpace)
      Parses the given command tokens and provides typing hints or suggestions based on the current input. This method updates the CommandParser.safeJLabel() with relevant information, such as command matches, usage hints, or error messages.
      Parameters:
      init - The initial list of CmdToken objects, including any tagged arguments, representing the user's input.
      endsWithSpace - A boolean indicating whether the user's input currently ends with a space.

    • findUsages

      public ArrayList<String> findUsages(String alias, ArrayList<String> usages, ArrayList<CmdToken> tokens)
      Filters a list of command usages based on the provided command tokens. It iteratively narrows down the possible usages by checking if each token's type is compatible with the corresponding argument in the usage string.
      Parameters:
      alias - The alias of the command being used.
      usages - An array of all possible usage strings for the command.
      tokens - An ArrayList of CmdToken objects representing the user's input arguments.
      Returns:
      An ArrayList of String containing the usage strings that are compatible with the given tokens.

    • similarTypes

      public boolean similarTypes(CmdToken token, String usage)
      Determines if a given command token's type is compatible with a specified usage string. This method checks for various type matches, including generic ("any"), string, typed arguments, numbers, and specific object references (UUIDs).
      Parameters:
      token - The CmdToken representing the user's input argument.
      usage - The expected usage string for an argument, e.g., <string>, <int>, [option1|option2], or <vector3>.
      Returns:
      true if the token's type is similar or compatible with the usage string, false otherwise.

    • possibleCommandAliasMatches

      private SamePair<ArrayList<InlineHTML>> possibleCommandAliasMatches(CmdToken token)
      Finds and styles possible command alias matches based on the given command token. It categorises matches into "likely" (aliases starting with the input) and "partial" (aliases containing the input but not starting with it), and styles them accordingly.
      Parameters:
      token - The CmdToken representing the user's current input for a command name.
      Returns:
      A SamePair containing two ArrayLists of InlineHTML. The first list contains likely matches, and the second contains partial matches.

    • onTabComplete

      public QuadConsumer<ArrayList<CmdToken>,Action,ActionEvent,ArrayList<String>> onTabComplete()
      Provides a QuadConsumer that handles tab completion logic for the command palette. This consumer attempts to complete the current command name or argument based on available aliases and suggestions. If no specific completion is found, it delegates to the default Action.
      Returns:
      A QuadConsumer that takes:
      • An ArrayList of CmdToken representing the current input.
      • The default Action to perform if no completion is possible.
      • The ActionEvent that triggered the completion.
      • An ArrayList of String containing potential completion options.

    • colourTaggedArgs

      private InlineHTML colourTaggedArgs(InlineHTML rich, Command command, ArrayList<CmdToken> init)
      Appends a hint for tagged arguments to the given InlineHTML based on the command's support for tagged arguments and whether any tagged arguments are present in the input.
      Parameters:
      rich - The current InlineHTML to append to.
      command - The Command for which the hints are being generated.
      init - The initial list of CmdTokens, including any tagged arguments.
      Returns:
      The modified InlineHTML with the tagged argument hint appended and styled.

    • colourGivenUsage

      public InlineHTML colourGivenUsage(String usage, ArrayList<CmdToken> tokens)
      Styles a given command usage string based on the provided user input tokens. This method provides visual feedback (colors) to indicate whether each argument in the usage string is correctly typed, partially matched, or incorrectly typed by the user.
      Parameters:
      usage - The expected command usage string, e.g., "mycommand [option1|option2] ".
      tokens - An ArrayList of CmdToken representing the user's parsed input.
      Returns:
      A InlineHTML object containing the styled usage string.

    • partialType

      private InlineHTML partialType(String arg)
      Colours the given type as partially correct. Partial matches are usually those who aren't a fully enclosed typed and get parsed as a string. These include:
      • Color #...
      • Vector3 (...
      • UUID <uuid like string>
      • invalid input: '{@link /*missing*/}'
      Parameters:
      arg - The expected arg string, like <vector3> or [p|r|e]
      Returns:
      A styled InlineHTML which colours the given expected argument PARTIAL_MATCH
